fee_economics.destination_behavior: Successful payable calls retain value in the contract. No refund, withdrawal, transfer, or burn-equivalent method exists in Beacon V1.
fee_economics.reverted_call_behavior: GenLayer value-transfer semantics apply; Beacon defines no refund path.
fee_economics.limitation: Fixed non-refundable Testnet V1 anti-spam fees are intentionally retained indefinitely unless a future contract version adds an explicitly supported recovery policy.

objective_sources.preflight: Both exact endpoints returned HTTP 200 with matching USDC identity, USD price, volume, market-cap, and freshness fields.

semantic_sources.preflight: All five exact server-rendered official Circle pages returned HTTP 200 and role-relevant content over the external read-only network.
